INSERT INTO auth_rate_limits (key, attempts, window_started_at, blocked_until)
     VALUES (?, 1, ?, 0)
     ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET
       attempts = CASE
         WHEN auth_rate_limits.blocked_until > ? THEN auth_rate_limits.attempts
         WHEN auth_rate_limits.window_started_at <= ? THEN 1
         ELSE auth_rate_limits.attempts + 1
       END,
       window_started_at = CASE
         WHEN auth_rate_limits.window_started_at <= ? THEN ?
         ELSE auth_rate_limits.window_started_at
       END,
       blocked_until = CASE
         WHEN auth_rate_limits.blocked_until > ? THEN auth_rate_limits.blocked_until
         WHEN auth_rate_limits.window_started_at > ? AND auth_rate_limits.attempts + 1 > ? THEN ?
         ELSE 0
       END
     RETURNING attempts, blocked_until

WITH reward_input(seen_since,xp_amount) AS (SELECT ?,?), sources AS (
      SELECT p.* FROM monster_participants mp JOIN players p ON p.id=mp.player_id
      WHERE mp.monster_id=? AND mp.spawn_round=?
      AND (? IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monsters m WHERE m.id=mp.monster_id AND m.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND m.hp>0 AND m.hp<=?))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monster_xp_claims c WHERE c.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND c.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND c.player_id=mp.player_id)
       AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM normal_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sinsi_reward_claims r WHERE r.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND r.spawn_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM boss_reward_claims r WHERE (mp.monster_id='dunya-bosu-1' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM loadlab_boss_rounds_v1 lab_round WHERE lab_round.monster_id=mp.monster_id AND lab_round.boss_round=mp.spawn_round)) AND r.boss_round=mp.spawn_round AND r.player_id=mp.player_id)
    ),peers AS (SELECT source.id AS source_id,cached.ally_id AS ally_id FROM sources source JOIN temp.kernel511_reward_peers_r531 cached ON cached.source_id=source.id UNION ALL 
    SELECT source.id AS source_id,ally.id AS ally_id FROM sources source
    JOIN party_members mine ON mine.player_id=source.id
    JOIN party_members team ON team.party_id=mine.party_id AND team.player_id<>source.id
    JOIN players ally ON ally.id=team.player_id
    WHERE 1=1 AND source.hp>0 AND MAX(source.last_seen,CAST(source.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(source.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input) AND ally.hp>0 AND MAX(ally.last_seen,CAST(ally.movement_checked_at_ms/1000 AS INTEGER),CAST(ally.last_monster_hit_at/1000 AS INTEGER))>=(SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)
    AND ally.area=source.area AND ally.channel=source.channel AND ally.arena_match_id=source.arena_match_id
    AND (ally.x-source.x)*(ally.x-source.x)+(ally.y-source.y)*(ally.y-source.y)<=5760000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM temp.kernel511_reward_sources_r531 covered WHERE covered.id=source.id))
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO monster_xp_claims(monster_id,spawn_round,player_id,claim_token,awarded_at)
    SELECT ?,?,id,?,? FROM(SELECT id FROM sources UNION SELECT ally_id FROM peers)

WITH RECURSIVE reward_input(seen_since,xp_amount) AS (SELECT ?,?), unused_token_r531 AS (SELECT ?), ranked AS(SELECT bucket,player_id,member_count,member_rank FROM temp.kernel511_reward_ranked_r531 WHERE recipe_id=(SELECT recipe FROM temp.kernel511_reward_state_r531)), amounts AS(SELECT player_id,SUM(CAST((SELECT xp_amount FROM reward_input)*(100+2*(MIN(5,member_count)-1))/100 AS INTEGER)) AS amount FROM ranked GROUP BY player_id),
    boosted AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.id,ROUND(a.amount*(1+COALESCE((SELECT CASE s.active_level WHEN 1 THEN .05 WHEN 2 THEN .07 WHEN 3 THEN .15 ELSE 0 END FROM guild_skills s JOIN guild_members m ON m.guild_id=s.guild_id WHERE m.player_id=p.id AND s.active_until>unixepoch()*1000),0))*(CASE WHEN p.xp_ring_until>? THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_pets WHERE player_id=p.id AND acquired_at+604800>unixepoch() AND equipped=1 AND kind='dog') THEN 1.2 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_pets WHERE player_id=p.id AND acquired_at+604800>unixepoch() AND equipped=1 AND kind IN ('bird','monkey')) THEN 1.1 ELSE 1 END)*(1+(COALESCE((SELECT CASE i.item_name WHEN 'Bilgelik Kemeri' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END FROM player_items i WHERE i.player_id=p.id AND i.kind='belt' AND i.equipped=1 AND i.rarity='crafted' AND i.power=0 AND i.role='all' AND i.enchantments='[]' AND i.expires_at_ms=0 AND i.premium_origin=0 LIMIT 1),0))/100.0)*(CASE WHEN p.halloween_candy_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN p.arena_exp_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END)*(CASE WHEN p.pumpkin_enabled499=1 AND p.pumpkin_until499>CAST(ROUND((julianday('now')-2440587.5)*86400000) AS INTEGER) THEN 1.25 WHEN p.radiant_enabled=1 AND p.radiant_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.2 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM player_items WHERE player_id=p.id AND kind='costume' AND equipped=1) THEN 1.2 ELSE 1 END)) AS amount FROM amounts a JOIN players p ON p.id=a.player_id),
    curve(level,total_xp,next_cost) AS(SELECT 1,0,CAST(json_extract((SELECT xp_curve_json FROM game_settings WHERE id=1),'$[0]') AS INTEGER)
    UNION ALL SELECT level+1,total_xp+next_cost,COALESCE(CAST(json_extract((SELECT xp_curve_json FROM game_settings WHERE id=1),'$['||level||']') AS INTEGER),0) FROM curve WHERE level<65)
    UPDATE players SET battle_pass_xp=CASE WHEN players.area<>'afk' AND (CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1 AND enabled=1 AND season_id<>'' AND starts_at<=(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000) AND ends_at>(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000)) THEN MIN((SELECT xp_cap FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1),(CASE WHEN players.battle_pass_season=(SELECT season_id FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1) THEN players.battle_pass_xp ELSE 0 END)+CAST((CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END) AS INTEGER)) ELSE players.battle_pass_xp END,battle_pass_season=CASE WHEN players.area<>'afk' AND (CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END)) ELSE (SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id) END)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1 AND enabled=1 AND season_id<>'' AND starts_at<=(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000) AND ends_at>(((SELECT seen_since FROM reward_input)+30)*1000)) THEN (SELECT season_id FROM battle_pass_settings WHERE id=1) ELSE players.battle_pass_season END,rank_xp=CASE WHEN level>=65 AND rank_tier>0 THEN MIN(9000000000000,rank_xp+ROUND((SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)*(CASE WHEN players.wisdom_until>unixepoch()*1000 THEN 1.25 ELSE 1 END))) ELSE rank_xp END,xp=CASE WHEN level>=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END) THEN xp ELSE MIN((SELECT total_xp FROM curve WHERE level=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END)),xp+(SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)) END,level=MAX(level,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(level) FROM curve WHERE level<=(CASE WHEN (SELECT expansion65_enabled FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)=1 OR (players.is_gm=1 AND players.id=(SELECT expansion65_preview_player_id FROM game_settings WHERE id=1)) THEN 65 ELSE 50 END) AND total_xp<=xp+(SELECT amount FROM boosted WHERE id=players.id)),1))
    WHERE id IN(SELECT player_id FROM monster_xp_claims WHERE claim_token=?) AND id IN(SELECT id FROM boosted) RETURNING id,xp,level,rank_xp

WITH drops(drop_row) AS (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
     INSERT OR IGNORE INTO world_drops
       (id, owner_id, monster_id, kind, item_name, rarity, power, amount, role, enchantments,
        x, y, expires_at, collectible_at)
     SELECT
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[0]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[1]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[2]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[3]') AS TEXT),
       json_extract(drop_row, '$[4]'),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[5]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[6]') AS INTEGER),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[7]') AS INTEGER),
       json_extract(drop_row, '$[8]'),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[9]') AS TEXT),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[10]') AS REAL),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[11]') AS REAL),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[12]') AS INTEGER),
       CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[13]') AS INTEGER)
     FROM drops
     WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM boss_reward_claims claim
       WHERE claim.boss_round = ? AND claim.player_id = CAST(json_extract(drop_row, '$[1]') AS TEXT)
         AND claim.claim_token = ?)
